entry.name: metro
entry.digest: Output a bang message at regular intervals
entry.description: Acts as a metronome which outputs bang s at a regular, specified interval. This object uses the Max time format syntax, so the interval that the metro object uses can be either fixed or tempo-relative.

arguments.name: interval
arguments.description: The optional first argument sets an initial value for the time interval at whichsends its output. This time interval can be either a number which specifies time in milliseconds (e.g. metro 100) or(e.g. metro 4n).Note: While theobject lets you specify time in any of Max's standard, theattribute argument should be used when specifying time in any other time unit besides milliseconds or notevalues (e.g.).If there is no argument, the initial time interval is 5 milliseconds.

attributes.digest: Activation flag
attributes.description: Turns the metro on and off.

attributes.description: If the autostart attribute is enabled (non-zero) the metro will begin running automatically at the time specified with the this attribute. The autostart operates as aobject that is internal to metro.
